title: Control room
loginText: For the Pilotix team only: shops, trials, payments and plans.
serverOnly: The control room runs on your server (pilotix.online/#/platform), not in the preview.
dashSub: Your shops, their trials, their payments, at a glance.
shopsSub: Each shop has its own data, its own team and its own plan.
plansSub: Each plan's price, its limits, and the menus it gives.
staffSub: Who can enter the control room, and what they can do.
settingsSub: Free trial, how shops pay you, a message to every shop.

demoSub: A shop full of fake orders, for interested customers to try.

roleText.owner: Everything: plans, prices, team, settings, cancelling a payment.
roleText.manager: Creates shops, records payments, suspends, changes menus.
roleText.support: Sees the shops, opens them to help, writes notes.

k.mrrHelp: The monthly price of the plans of every active (paid) shop, added up.
k.pendingHelp: They filled “Create my store” but haven’t clicked the e-mail link yet (it works for 48 hours).
k.conversionHelp: Of the stores created by sign-up in the last 90 days, how many made at least one payment.

ownShopLong: Your own shop: everything included, it never stops.
demoShopLong: Demo shop (made-up data, reset every night).
openHelp: Opens the shop in a new tab as its administrator, to help it (2 hours, written in the journal).
suspendText: The shop is locked at once: its team sees a “Shop suspended” screen and its public links (landing pages, webhooks) stop answering. Its data is kept. You can reactivate it any time (a recorded payment reactivates it too).
archiveText: The shop is closed: nobody can log in any more and its links stop answering. Its data is kept and you can reactivate it.
createdText: “{{name}}” is ready. Send these login details to the owner:
createdOnce: The password is shown only once. The owner can change it in My profile › Security.

rule.learnText: When an order ends as “fake”, “wrong number” or a return, the shop remembers the number and the device that ordered.
rule.privateText: The network only keeps a secret fingerprint: never the customer’s number, name or address.
rule.twoText: A number only counts when {{count}} different sellers flagged it. One seller alone, or a competitor, cannot smear a number.

tip.no_order: Lead: most leave without ordering. The coach can approve lessons to follow up and close sooner.
tip.refused: Lead: refused parcels. Lessons to repeat the total, the size and the address before ordering can help.

learn.title: How Dellal learns
learn.help: Pilot AI’s loop, every day. The numbers come from the engine itself: this drawing always tells the truth.
learn.lead: Dellal never changes on its own. Every day it sells; every night Pilot AI looks at what really worked; every morning a person decides; then the delivered parcels judge.

day.text: It answers customers with its method and the current lesson book. Each chat keeps the version of the book it got.

night.text: The finished chats, with no names or numbers. A delivered parcel = a win, a refused parcel = a loss. It writes short lessons.

morning.text: Someone on the Pilotix team reads each lesson with the chats behind it: approve, edit or reject.

test.text: The new book is tried on {{share}} % of new chats. After {{days}} days it is kept only if it gets at least as many parcels delivered.

learn.again: Then it starts again: every night Dellal learns a little more.
learn.scoreLead: When a chat is finished, Pilot AI scores it by what became of the parcel:
learn.gold: A chat a teammate took over that then got delivered is a “gold example”: it counts {{gold}} times.

rule.win: Only a parcel delivered and paid is a real win: a refused order costs the shop money.
rule.safe: A lesson is short, with no numbers, prices, discounts or promises: otherwise it is blocked before it even reaches the coach.
rule.short: The book stays short (about one page): the most useful lessons come first. The coach never has more than {{open}} lessons to read at once.
rule.brain: For each message Dellal picks its brain: Haiku (fast and cheap) for simple messages, Sonnet (stronger) for hard moments: price, trust, anger, a big order, asking for a person.
rule.test: The test compares at least {{min}} chats on each side, {{days}} days old (the time deliveries take), for {{max}} days at most. A book that clearly does worse is stopped on its own.
rule.budget: The night has a budget: {{usd}} $ at most (Settings & costs tab).

social.title: Boutiques’ Meta and TikTok accounts
social.text: Boutiques link their Facebook and TikTok accounts in one click (Pilot AI › Accounts). For that, Pilotix needs its own Meta app and TikTok app. Their secret keys stay here, on the server.
social.configHint: Recommended: a « User access token » configuration. Sellers log in with their own Facebook account; their Pages stay linked with no end date, and ad numbers need a new login about every 60 days. « System-user » needs a business portfolio and Tech Provider status at Meta.
social.how: How to make the two apps
metaSteps: On developers.facebook.com, create an app of the “Business” type.
Add the products Facebook Login for Business, Messenger, Instagram and Webhooks.
In Facebook Login › Settings, paste the return address.
In Webhooks, paste the webhook address and the verify token. Subscribe to “Page” (messages, feed) and “Instagram” (messages, comments).
Paste the app ID and its secret (Settings › Basic) here, then save.
Meta reviews the app (App Review) before other sellers’ Pages work. Your own Pages work at once.
tiktokSteps: On business-api.tiktok.com, create an app and ask for Marketing API access.
Paste the return address in “Advertiser redirect URL”.
Paste the App ID and the Secret here, then save. TikTok approves the app in one to two weeks.
